$comment: Auto Dealer + Harbor + Airfield. type: bike | scooter | kart | car | boat | plane. topSpeed in m/s. depreciation = yearly fraction of value lost. upkeep = monthly cost (fuel, maintenance). insurance category 'auto' covers repair events for cars, boats and planes.

items.name: City Bike
items.blurb: Free to ride, good exercise, and almost no upkeep.

items.name: Trick BMX
items.blurb: Lighter and faster than the city bike.

items.name: Go-Kart
items.blurb: Pure fun! Not practical, but very fun.

items.name: Used Hatchback
items.blurb: A reliable used car. Cheaper, but repairs pop up more often.

items.name: New Compact Car
items.blurb: Brand new, under warranty, loses value fast in year one.

items.name: Electric Sedan
items.blurb: Cheap to fuel, expensive to buy.

items.name: Pickup Truck
items.blurb: Big, useful for business, thirsty for fuel.

items.name: Sports Coupe
items.blurb: Very fast. Very expensive to own. Status symbol, not an investment.

items.name: Speedboat
items.blurb: Fast on the water. Docking, fuel and maintenance add up!

items.name: Little Seaplane
items.blurb: Fly over Fin City! Huge upkeep: fuel, hangar and inspections.
